verdict.rationale: Relay is an online business banking platform, and an official CLI is a fair question for that kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a command-line tool. The documentation describes only the web and mobile app, accounting integrations and Plaid connections, and the llms.txt probe shows only an AI-readable docs file, not a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
